property_summary: For any caller address X and non-zero newOwner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) reverts for non-owner callers on the correct contract (only the current owner can transfer ownership); the mutant removing the onlyOwner modifier allows non-owners to change owner, violating this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Changed the visibility guard so anyone can call transferOwnership by removing onlyOwner modifier, allowing non-owner callers to change owner.
